The '''''Pelta''-class frigate''' was a highly modular [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] used by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] personnel as both a medical frigate and cargo frigate during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:PeltaclassFrigateTCWIV.png|thumb|left|200px|Aft view of a ''Pelta''-class frigate with auxiliary engines visible.]]
The medical variant of the ''Pelta''-class frigate was painted with the characteristic red markings of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. In appearance, the class bore similarities in design to [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|CEC's]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] and [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigates]], and had a command tower similar to [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruisers]]. Medical frigates of this type were equipped with at least 4 [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]].<ref name="SOM" />

In order to maneuver more smoothly through space, the frigate was capable of opening up a set of wings to expose smaller auxiliary engines.<ref name="SOM" /> The wings were usually folded up to minimize the ship's profile. The interiors could easily be switched out to conform to different mission assignments in a matter of hours.<ref name="TCWCG" />

The frigates had heavy armor, as well 2 light [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries, 3 point-defense [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] batteries and 3 [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] batteries to defend themselves with.<ref name="TCWCG" /><ref name="PM:CWT" /> The cargo variant sported gray hull plating, contained a large interior for transporting supplies and, unlike the medical frigate, was armed.<ref name="TVB" /> An example of this frigate was [[TB-73/Legends|TB-73]].

==History==
[[File:Pelta_Hyenas.jpg|thumb|left|180px|''Pelta''-class frigate attacked by ''Hyena''-class bombers.]]

The ''Pelta''-class was often used in conjunction with [[MedStar-class frigate/Legends|''MedStar''-class frigates]], leading to them often being called "medical frigates" despite the modular design.<ref name="TCWCG" />

Republic medical frigates in the vicinity of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] were often directed to the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], which could support tens of thousands of patients. They became easy targets during the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence''s]] numerous strikes.<ref name="SOM" />

Some ''Pelta''-class frigates were still used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]'' refers to vehicles and tools from the ''Clone Wars Campaign Guide'' being free for use with the Imperial forces in the Rebellion era.</ref>
